l5-A-telescoping.claim: A never rotates: SPACE cycles A's form by body-cell count 4->5->9->10->13->10->9->5->4...; each added segment brings a prong (3..7 prongs). White cell=growing tip. Growth keeps body-bbox top-left fixed.

l5-WIN.claim: L5 solved step 443: full-pairing config (14 prongs in 7 gray pairs) = win. Goal = every prong cell has exactly 2 prongs. A oscillates 4-5-9-10-13-10-9-5 on SPACE.

l5-click-semantics.claim: MOUSE on inactive object cell activates it; MOUSE on ACTIVE object cell DESELECTS (all cells charcoal, arrows become no-ops). Verify object is active (colored body) before batching moves.

l5-goal.claim: Goal = every prong cell holds exactly 2 prongs (all gray, none red). A grown to 7 prongs (form13) gives 14 prongs = 7 pairs; with A at 3/5 prongs full pairing is impossible (search).

l5-rules.claim: Prong render: exactly 2 coincident -> gray G (engaged); 1 or 3 -> red. So engagement needs exactly a pair. L5 start has pieces SCATTERED (A left, C top-right, D bottom-right) and 0 gray cells.

l5-solution.claim: Full-pairing config (anchor=body-bbox TL): A form13@(7,7); B rot0@(7,9); C rot0@(8,4); D rot3@(11,11). Pairs (7,8)(9,9)B, (8,6)(10,6)(12,6)C, (11,11)(13,10)D. Execute after reset.
